map.为什么要降到 200℃ 以下再开窑？: Why cool below 200°C before opening the kiln?
map.估算各阶段耗时与总烧成时间，安排窑炉排程。: Estimate the time for each stage and the total firing time to schedule the kiln.

map.急冷会使釉面与坯体因收缩不均而惊裂（尤其含方石英的坯体），自然缓冷至 200℃: Rapid cooling causes crazing as glaze and body shrink unevenly (especially bodies containing cristobalite), so cooling naturally to below 200°C before opening the kiln significantly lowers the cracking risk.

map.石英在 573℃ 发生晶型转变并伴随体积突变，升温过快易导致坯体开裂，因此 60: Quartz undergoes a crystal form transition at 573°C with a sudden volume change, and heating too fast can crack the body, so the 600→800°C range needs a moderate, steady rate.

map.陶艺烧制温度曲线 使用指南: Pottery firing temperature curve user guide
map.：峰值温度：釉烧 = 泥料最高温度 − 80℃，素烧 = 泥料最高温度。泥料最高: : peak temperature: glaze firing = clay maximum temperature − 80°C, bisque = clay maximum temperature. Clay maximum temperatures (°C): porcelain 1350, stoneware (high fire) 1280, low fire 1100, terracotta 1050, raku 1000. Bisque stages: room→150°C (50°C/h, about 3h to remove physical water), 150→300°C (100°C/h), 300→600°C (120°C/h, organic oxidation), 600→800°C (150°C/h, passing the 573°C quartz transition), 800→peak (150°C/h), soak, then cool naturally to below 200°C before opening the kiln. Glaze firing heats slightly faster: 60/120/150/200/150 °C/h with a 20-30 min final soak to level the glaze.
map.：炻器泥素烧：峰值取 1280℃，800→1280 段耗时 = (1280−80: : for stoneware bisque firing the peak is 1280°C, and the 800→1280 stage takes (1280−800)/150 ≈ 3.2 h, so with the earlier stages around 8.3 h plus soaking and 6-8 h cooling a full kiln run is about 18 h. Glaze firing the same clay peaks at 1280−80 = 1200°C, and the 800→1200 stage takes about 2.7 h.
